title: Columbus off the Caribbean coast
description: On his fourth voyage Columbus anchors off the coast and trades with the local people, the first recorded European contact.

title: Cartago founded
description: Juan Vázquez de Coronado founds the town that becomes the colonial capital.

title: Talamanca revolt
description: The people of Talamanca rise against the Spanish missions; the region stays effectively independent of the colony for generations.

title: San José founded
description: Villagers in the central valley are grouped into a new parish, the origin of the capital.

title: Independence accepted
description: Weeks after the news arrives, the provincial authorities ratify the Central American declaration of independence from Spain.

title: Battle of Ochomogo
description: Republican militia from San José defeat the imperialists of Cartago, and the capital moves to San José.

title: Guanacaste joins Costa Rica
description: The Partido de Nicoya votes to leave Nicaragua and join Costa Rica, forming the later province of Guanacaste.

title: Sovereignty declared
description: Costa Rica secedes from the failing Federal Republic of Central America and becomes a sovereign state.

title: Republic proclaimed
description: José María Castro Madriz formally declares Costa Rica an independent republic, closing the federal era.

title: Death of Juan Santamaría
description: A drummer boy from Alajuela dies torching the filibusters' stronghold at Rivas and becomes the national hero.

title: Battle of Santa Rosa
description: A Costa Rican army routs William Walker's filibusters at the Hacienda Santa Rosa, the opening of the national filibuster war.

title: Era of elections begins
description: A new constitution begins nearly continuous electoral government and establishes free and compulsory education.

title: Cartago earthquake
description: An earthquake destroys much of the old capital and kills several hundred people.

title: Tinoco coup
description: The War Minister seizes power, the one break in Costa Rica's constitutional history before 1948.

title: Civil war
description: After a rejected election result José Figueres launches an armed uprising that kills about two thousand and wins in 44 days.

title: Army abolished
description: The victorious junta abolishes the army, and the next year's constitution makes abolition permanent.

title: Constitution of 1949
description: The new constitution of the Second Republic comes into force, extending the vote, creating the electoral tribunal and barring a standing army.

title: Irazú eruption
description: Irazú begins two years of eruptions that coat the central valley in ash, starting on the day of President Kennedy's visit.

title: Arenal eruption
description: Long thought extinct, Arenal explodes and buries three villages, killing about ninety people.

title: Nobel Peace Prize
description: President Óscar Arias wins the Nobel Peace Prize for his plan that ends the Central American wars.

title: Limón earthquake
description: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake wrecks the Caribbean coast and raises whole stretches of shoreline.

title: First female president
description: Laura Chinchilla wins the presidency in a first-round landslide.
